question: The religious festival, 'Easter' is celebrated by which community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Christian community**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Easter** is one of the most significant religious festivals celebrated by the **Christian community worldwide**.
 
• It commemorates the **resurrection of Jesus Christ**, which is believed to have occurred three days after his crucifixion.
 
• **Easter Sunday** marks the end of the Holy Week and the season of Lent, a 40-day period of fasting, prayer, and reflection.
 
• The date of Easter varies each year and is based on the **lunar calendar**, typically falling on the first Sunday after the full moon following the spring equinox.
 
• Easter celebrations often include church services, feasts, and customs like **decorating Easter eggs** and organizing egg hunts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Christianity:**

 
 
• Christianity is a monotheistic religion centered on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ, considered the Son of God.
 
• It is the **world's largest religion**, with over 2.3 billion adherents globally.
 
• Key denominations include Roman Catholicism, Protestantism, and Eastern Orthodoxy.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Easter:**
 
 
• Easter symbolizes hope, renewal, and the victory of life over death.
 
• It is the culmination of the Paschal mystery, which includes Christ's passion, death, and resurrection.
 
 
 
• **Lent:**
 
 
• Lent is a solemn observance lasting 40 days, excluding Sundays, leading up to Easter.
 
• It is characterized by practices such as fasting, prayer, and almsgiving.
 
 
 
• **Easter Traditions:**
 
 
• Common traditions include sunrise services, Easter egg decoration, and festive meals.
 
• The Easter Bunny is a popular secular symbol associated with Easter celebrations.
